mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE (t1.num,0) as taskNum, mc.market_tenant, mc.market_name FROM market_config mc LEFT JOIN (select spt.market_tenant,spt.market_name, count(spt.market_name) as num from safety_patrol_task spt
and spt.create_time >= #{query.period.begin} and spt.create_time < #{query.period.end}
and spt.result_code = 'ABNORMAL'
group by spt.market_tenant ) t1 ON mc.market_tenant = t1.market_tenant
mc.status = true
and mc.market_tenant = #{query.marketTenant}
order by taskNum desc
